content: The guideline text was prepared by Dennis Falzon and Licé González-Angulo, with contributions from Alexei Korobitsyn, under the supervision of Ernesto Jaramillo and Karin Weyer, and overall direction from Mario Raviglione, Director of the WHO Global Tuberculosis Programme (GTB). The document underwent review and finalization based on input from the Guideline Development Group (GDG), the External Review Group (ERG), and the WHO Guideline Steering Committee before submission to the WHO Guideline Review Committee (GRC) in June 2017. The development of these guidelines was financially supported by the United States Agency for International Development (USAID) through the WHO-USAID grant (Grant number GHA-G-00-09-00003/US-2014-827). Additionally, the American Thoracic Society (ATS), Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), Infectious Diseases Society of America (IDSA), and WHO/GTB collaborated to exchange results from their respective analyses to inform the revision of tuberculosis (TB) guidelines. The WHO treatment guidelines for multidrug-resistant and rifampicin-resistant tuberculosis (MDR/RR-TB) were updated in 2018. The recommendations were developed following discussions by the GDG convened by the WHO GTB in Versoix, Switzerland, from July 16 to 20, 2018. WHO expressed gratitude to the numerous MDR/RR-TB patients whose data contributed to the development of these guidelines. The GDG was chaired by Holger Schünemann, a GRADE methodologist, and co-chaired by Geraint (Rhys) Davies, with contributions from other GDG members, including experts in clinical practice, public health, and program management. WHO also acknowledged the systematic reviews and individual patient data analyses conducted by a team from McGill University, Canada, including Syed Abidi, Faiz Ahmad Khan, Jonathon Campbell, Zhiyi Lan, and Dick Menzies. The guideline development process was supported by experts from the ERG, who provided comments on the draft document before its finalization. The writing of the guidelines was coordinated by Dennis Falzon and Kerri Viney under the supervision of Ernesto Jaramillo and Karin Weyer, with overall direction from Tereza Kasaeva, Director of WHO/GTB. The 2011 update of the guidelines for the programmatic management of drug-resistant TB was coordinated by Dennis Falzon under the guidance of Ernesto Jaramillo and Léopold Blanc of WHO’s Stop TB Department. Contributions from various experts and technical groups were acknowledged, including those specializing in clinical practice, epidemiology, program management, and laboratory sciences. The 2016 update of the WHO treatment guidelines for drug-resistant TB was developed by an ad hoc GDG convened in Geneva, Switzerland, from November 9 to 11, 2015. The GDG was chaired by Holger Schünemann and co-chaired by Charles L. Daley, with input from experts in clinical practice, public health, and epidemiology. The guidelines were finalized following an iterative process of comments from the GDG, ERG, and WHO Guideline Steering Committee, and submitted to the WHO GRC in March 2016. The 2017 update of the guidelines for the treatment of drug-susceptible TB and patient care was developed by a GDG convened in Geneva, Switzerland, from July 11 to 13, 2016. The GDG meeting was chaired by Holger Schünemann, who led the evaluation of evidence that informed the revision of the guidelines. WHO expressed gratitude to the GDG members and external reviewers who contributed to the development and review of the guidelines. The development of these guidelines was supported by financial contributions from USAID through various grants. WHO also acknowledged the contributions of its staff and external collaborators who provided technical guidance and administrative support throughout the guideline development process.
